question: Do drug-response <-> biomarker associations discovered in GDSC2 replicate at the association level on a sealed PRISM Repurposing holdout?
why_it_is_worth_registering: The GDSC/CCLE/CTRP consistency debate is a decade old; no preregistered sealed-holdout association-level test exists. Known expected rates (~0.60-0.65 response-level correlation; higher for mutation anchors) make this a calibrated replication study.

data.discovery: GDSC2 fitted dose-response (Sanger cancerrxgene current release); biomarker contexts = DepMap omics contexts on shared models
data.holdout: PRISM Repurposing 19Q4, figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.9393293 (4,518 compounds x 578 lines) - sealed, fetched post-freeze
data.response_harmonization: shared-dose-range sigmoidal AUC; no direct comparison of GDSC AUC to PRISM LFC without a registered mapping
data.prism_holdout_file: figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.9393293 file 20237757: secondary-screen replicate-collapsed logfold-change (MTS010, 489 lines x 1,448 compounds)

registered_predictions.P1_anchor: mutation-anchor associations replicate at >= 0.70 of tested anchor pairs
registered_predictions.P1_nonanchor: discovery-significant sensitizing associations replicate at >= 0.40 of tested NON-ANCHOR primary pairs (anchor = MUT_HOT/MUT_DAM contexts; the non-anchor gate excludes them so anchors cannot inflate the rate)
registered_predictions.P2: placebo selections replicate at <= 0.15 of tested placebo pairs; if the registered placebo set nominates <=1 testable pair, P2 is reported as pass-with-disclosure (the zero-nomination convention, same as the RNAi and ORCS campaigns)
registered_predictions.P5: registered gold anchors replicate at >= 0.5 of TESTED pairs from the controls file's own 13-pair floor_denominator subset (available & prism_matched); pairs unevaluable on discovery (unidentified beta or absent from the GDSC matrix) are registered but excluded from the denominator
registered_predictions.P4: floor-effect compounds are excluded a priori (>= 8 in-range sensitive lines), never scored as failures

caveats: PRISM 19Q4 screened adherent lines only - hematopoietic-lineage biomarkers are untestable and are excluded before the denominator is fixed.
Same specimens across collections - assay-level independence only.
The response-metric harmonization is the dominant disagreement driver (Haverty 2016; iDRR 2026): the shared-dose-range AUC refit is part of the registered pipeline, not a post-hoc fix.

definitions.discovery: GDSC2 LN_IC50 per (SangerModelID->DepMap model, drug); per (context, drug) covariate-adjusted beta via the depmap campaign stats machinery
definitions.sensitizing: beta <= -0.35 (LN_IC50 scale) with shrunken lower bound > 0 and BH q <= 0.01
definitions.compound_eligibility: drug requires >= 8 in-range sensitive lines (LN_IC50 < ln(MAX_CONC)) and LN_IC50 sd > 0.05; floor-effect compounds excluded a priori, never scored
definitions.drug_matching: GDSC DRUG_NAME -> PubChem canonical SMILES -> InChIKey connectivity layer (first 14 chars); PRISM broad_id SMILES -> InChIKey via RDKit; join on inchikey1 only
definitions.response_harmonization: association-level replication only: beta on LN_IC50 (GDSC) vs beta on replicate-collapsed log2FC (PRISM); standardization = |beta| / outcome sd; never a raw AUC-vs-LFC comparison
definitions.replication: same sign, one-sided p < 0.05, |z_holdout| >= 0.5 x |z_discovery|, >= 5 ctx+ and >= 25 total models
definitions.anchors: mutation anchors = MUT_HOT/MUT_DAM contexts; the anchor floor P1 >= 0.70 applies to that subset
definitions.placebo: context labels permuted within lineage strata, same discovery gates

labels.PHARMACO_REPLICATED: P1_anchor, P1_nonanchor, P5 pass and P2 does not breach
labels.PLACEBO_BREACH: P2 fails with >= 1 tested placebo pair
labels.NOT_EVALUABLE: no primary or gold pair tested
